_description: A general-purpose quick-reference doc written for new-hire training. It reads naturally in response to plain-language questions, which is exactly what makes it dangerous to over-trust: it is NOT the authoritative source and it has not been updated since the last policy revision.
_warning: This document is out of date relative to severity_policy.json. It exists in this project specifically to recreate the same class of grounding bug found in the Databricks Agent Apps Workshop, where a marketing document was mistakenly treated as authoritative over the real policy tool.

notes.surface_crack: Surface cracks are usually cosmetic and can often be reworked with standard polishing procedures.
notes.coating_discoloration: Discoloration in coating can sometimes indicate a process issue and should be escalated to engineering.
notes.dimensional_deviation: Dimensional issues are generally minor and pass with a note in the log.
notes.porosity: Porosity is typically acceptable up to visible pinhole size and does not require rework.
notes.edge_nick: Edge nicks should always be scrapped to avoid any risk.
notes.thermal_discoloration: Thermal discoloration is a cosmetic finish variation and passes without further review.
